description: This file defines the WorkspaceSelection class, a Drupal plugin for entity reference selection with access control for workspace entities, including methods for configuration, entity retrieval, and dependency injection.

classes.name: WorkspaceSelection
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class providing access control and entity reference selection for workspace entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method for instantiating the plugin with dependency injection.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns default configuration settings for the plugin.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the plugin, disabling sorting options.

methods.name: getReferenceableEntities
methods.description: Retrieves and filters workspace entities that are referenceable, considering user access and optional search parameters.
